wish: someone should make a diary and habit tracker where you score each positive or negative event of the day
spec:
Log events for a day with a note and a score from -3 to +3. Type what happened, pick a score, tap Add; step back through days with the arrows, delete entries with the cross.
Shows the day total and a 14-day bar chart of daily totals, saved in this browser only.
No accounts, no sync, no export; the first view shows example entries until you add your own.
